observations.behavior: Adds a workflow step to extract and pass the Node.js version from the Dockerfile to the workflow, and adds a check to ensure the version is compatible with both amd64 and arm64 architectures.
observations.posthog_connection: This could allow the workflow to use a specific Node.js version instead of the default, potentially improving compatibility and performance.

observations.behavior: Adds a check to ensure the Node.js version is compatible with both amd64 and arm64 architectures, and adds a comment explaining the reason for this check.
observations.code_quote: nodejs_version=$(LC_ALL=C comm -12 <(nodejs_versions amd64) <(nodejs_versions arm64) | sort -V | tail -n1)
observations.posthog_connection: This could help prevent compatibility issues between different architectures, potentially improving reliability and performance.
